svg.text: Haier UART bridge schematic · distinct from the ordered PCB rev1.0
C2/C3: +3V3 to GND. EN: R1 pull-up to +3V3.
Haier and factory Wi-Fi share +5V and GND.
TX and RX labels refer to the adapter
BOOT: hold GPIO0 LOW while resetting EN
TX/RX labels refer to the factory module
Haier TX/RX pass through ESP; power is shared.
Keep factory Wi-Fi connected to +5V and GND.
Verify connector pin order on your Haier board.
RX dividers: 10 kΩ series + 20 kΩ to GND.
All GND symbols and matching net labels are connected.
GND EP41: thermal vias. U2 TAB: +3V3 copper area.
R and ceramics: 0805. C1/C3/C4/C6: 0.1 µF / 50 V.
JP1: close only at a bus end.
